enabled.description: Enable or disable the rdnssd daemon at boot.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0') to monitor for IPv6 Router Advertisements containing DNS server information.

max_ns.description: Maximum number of DNS servers to add per interface from Router Advertisement data. Too many servers may exceed resolver limits.

search_domains.description: Optional list of DNS search domains to append to /etc/resolv.conf. Requires resolver support (e.g., glibc 2.26+).

resolv_conf_path.description: Path to the resolver configuration file that rdnssd will update with discovered DNS servers.

pid_file_path.description: Path to the PID file used by rdnssd to store its process ID.

user.description: System user account to drop privileges to after startup for security.

systemd_socket_activation.description: Enable systemd socket activation for rdnssd (advanced; requires compatible systemd and rdnssd build).
